tasks.label: lmlab: profile CUDA smoke
tasks.command: cuda_home="$CUDA_HOME"; if [ -z "$cuda_home" ]; then cuda_home=/usr/local/cuda-13.3; fi; "$cuda_home/bin/ncu" --set basic --target-processes all --export "${workspaceFolder}/.build/ncu_smoke" --force-overwrite "${workspaceFolder}/.build/smoke_cuda"
